title: Mmiri dị n'okpuru ájá
intro: N'akwụkwọ akụkọ nke Quran, otu onye nwere ndidi dị ukwuu chere ule nke ga-agbaji obi ndị siri ike ihu. E wepụrụ ihe niile - akụnụba, ezinụlọ, na ahụike. Ma site n'ọdịda obi nkoropụ, a zara ekpere dị umeala n'obi n'ụzọ a na-atụghị anya ya. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta mkpụrụ obi a nke akụkọ mweghachi ahụ na-ada ụda kemgbe ọtụtụ afọ?
clues: E lere m ule siri ike nke na a na-echeta ya kemgbe ọtụtụ afọ.
M furu ihe niile dị mkpa - akụnụba m, ụmụ m, na ahụike m.
Ahụ́ m jupụtara n'ọnyá mgbu, mmadụ niile na-ajụkwa m.
N'ọnọdụ m na-enweghị olileanya, akpọkuru m Allah, na-ekwu na Setan metụrụ m aka site n'ihe isi ike na ahụhụ.
Allah zara m ma nye m iwu ka m kụọ ụwa site n'ụkwụ m.
Site n'ebe ahụ kpọmkwem, mmiri oyi gbapụtara, Chineke wee weghachi ezinụlọ m ma mee ka ha dị okpukpu abụọ dịka ebere.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
